Implemented a Zoe fixed price sale contract.

### Added

- [Contract](/Users/bc/Desktop/Agoric-L1/baseline/task1-codex/src/fixedPriceSale.js)
  - Price brand and amount supplied as contract terms.
  - Buyers give `Price` and request one `Item`.
  - Underpayments are rejected and refunded.
  - Creator can collect accumulated proceeds.

- [AVA tests](/Users/bc/Desktop/Agoric-L1/baseline/task1-codex/test/fixedPriceSale.test.js)
  - Successful purchase.
  - Refused underpayment, including payment refund and no item payout.

- Test configuration and Yarn lockfile.
- Yarn `node-modules` linker configuration required by Agoric’s bundle test tooling.

2 tests passed
```

yarn test
```
